explicit_disclaimer: This is a PARAMETRIC-BOOTSTRAP predictive check, NOT a posterior-predictive check (no posterior parameter samples are drawn). Coverage assumes the iid-Gaussian observation-noise model fitted at the MAP. Coverage near the nominal level is COMPATIBLE with that noise model for this trace; it is NOT evidence that the noise model is correct or well-calibrated in any stronger sense.
